args.subject: Billing Correction and Refund Processed for Tailspin Ltd
args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have corrected your billing record to reflect the contractually agreed seat count of 40 (previously recorded as 'not stored in CRM'). A refund of 80 units for the seat overcharge has been issued.

Your updated record and refund confirmation are now in our system. If you have further questions, reply to this email or contact support.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
